articles.title: Clarity Act could spark a boom in crypto ‘yield-as-a-service’
articles.snippet: The bill’s restrictions on yield-bearing crypto products may push the industry away from passive "hold-to-earn" models and toward AI-driven, compliant yield infrastructure, according to STBL Chief Commercial Officer Joe Vollono.

articles.title: Why Minnesota is empowering local banks to fight Wall Street for crypto revenue
articles.snippet: A local banker told CoinDesk that in light of Wall Street’s aggressive push into the crypto industry, Minnesota's financial institutions could not afford to remain on the sidelines.

articles.title: Tom Emmer brushes off law enforcement concerns over Clarity Act
articles.snippet: House Majority Whip Tom Emmer said concerns from law enforcement groups about crypto developer protections are being overstated.

articles.title: CFTC officials who questioned prediction markets were suspended: NYT
articles.snippet: A New York Times investigation found that senior CFTC officials who raised concerns about Polymarket, Crypto.com and Gemini were suspended and pushed out.

articles.title: Bitcoin 'Pizza Day' was 16 years ago, here's how much that BTC is worth today
articles.snippet: Laszlo Hanyecz's 2010 post, offering 10,000 BTC in exchange for two pizzas delivered to his home, marked the first recorded commercial BTC payment.
